# The Windows CI test projects and the stream each runs in (read by test-concurrent.sh).
# Format: <stream> <project directory> [timeout-minutes] [extra dotnet test args...]
#
# Streams run at the same time; projects inside one stream run one after another. A stream whose
# name starts with "mesa" gets GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe (Mesa's software GL, copied beside the test
# binaries by the "Install Mesa llvmpipe" step) and nothing else does. Every project in
# Tests/CiTestProjects.slnf must appear here exactly once, and the script fails fast otherwise.
#
# Keep the streams roughly balanced when adding a project; the slowest stream sets the wall time.

headless MonoGameGum.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.Bundle.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.ProjectServices.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.ImageDiff.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.Presentation.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.AssemblyNameGuard.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.RepoHygiene.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.Analyzers.Tests
headless Tests/SkiaGum.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.NetStandard.Tests
headless Tests/SilkNetGum.Tests
headless Tests/KniSkiaGum.Tests
headless Tests/UnityGum.Tests
headless Tests/StrideGum.Tests
headless Tests/Gum.ProjectServices.SkiaGum.Tests
# Real DirectX 11 devices on a window that is never shown; skips itself where the runner has no DirectX 11 adapter.
headless Tests/GumShadowDusk.Tests.MonoGameWindowsDX
headless Tests/GumShadowDusk.Tests.KniWindowsDX

# console;verbosity=normal streams every test's duration as it finishes, so a timeout still shows
# where the time went (#6078).
mesa-1 Tests/MonoGameGum.IntegrationTests 15 --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"
mesa-1 Tests/MonoGameGum.Shapes.Tests 10
mesa-1 Tests/GumShadowDusk.Tests.KniDesktopGL 10
mesa-1 Tests/SkiaGum.GpuTests 10 --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

mesa-2 Tests/Gum.Cli.Tests
mesa-2 Tests/RaylibGum.Tests 10
mesa-2 Tests/Gum.ProjectServices.Raylib.Tests 10
mesa-2 Tests/Gum.ProjectServices.MonoGame.Tests 10
